name: watchdog
description: Watchdog agents review each update of the agent you work with and push short notes to it. It spawns review subagents and auto-allows only its own review spawn and reviewer reads of files the main agent already read.

onByDefault.title: On by default
onByDefault.description: Turn the watchdog on in each new interactive session.

immuneTurns.title: Immune turns
immuneTurns.description: Main turns after a nudge before the next nudge for a concern (0 to 5).

hideNudgedNotes.title: Hide nudged notes
hideNudgedNotes.description: Show a note that goes to Claude by a nudge only in the nudge prompt: no transcript row and no card.

hideEmptyBand.title: Hide empty band
hideEmptyBand.description: Draw nothing above the prompt box while no note card shows and no watchdog has a problem.

nudgeNits.title: Nudge nits
nudgeNits.description: Send a nit as a concern goes: after the next tool result, or by a nudge after the reply.

hideUi.title: Hide UI
hideUi.description: Draw no band and write no note line while the session runs; error lines and command output still show.
